question.text: The first two stages of ODR (Pre-Conciliation and Conciliation) are:

answer.text: Free of cost for the investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Pre-conciliation and conciliation are the first two stages of the ODR framework and are free of cost for investors. The Trap: Options that allocate cost to the investor or split it between parties contradict the free-of-cost design of these initial stages. Note: Only the first two stages are stated to be free for investors.
